summary: Our very first client. One video, 538,000 views and more than $145,000 in enquiries later, we are still rather fond of her.

glance.label: At a glance
glance.overview: For two and a half years we ran Closet Fairy's social media end to end: the voice, the content, the shoots and the ads. One series, Client Journeys, became her best-performing content and brought in more than $145,000 of enquiries on its own.

brief: Sara Mahdavi was our very first client. She came to us as she was starting [Closet Fairy](https://closetfairy.com) and stepping into a new era as a personal stylist. She needed a brand that sounded like her, a presence that showed how she works, and an audience that would become clients.

chapters.title: Finding the voice
body: We began at the beginning: who Closet Fairy is, how she speaks and how she shows up. We defined the brand voice, and the way Sara would appear on social media as she stepped into her new era.
From there we took over her social media entirely, and carried the same voice onto her website through copywriting and blog posts.

chapters.title: Client Journeys
body: We created Client Journeys, a series that follows Sara's signature styling process from the first conversation to the finished wardrobe, with each client's result as the reveal.
It remains her best-performing content. A single video reached 538,000 views and brought in more than $145,000 of inbound enquiries. We ran the series for every client thereafter.

aside.label: Inbound enquiries from that video alone

chapters.title: Everything else, handled
body: Around Client Journeys we built the rest of the content mix, and every format earned its place among her top performers. We wrote, scripted, directed and edited all of it, and managed the account day to day.
We also turned Client Journeys into advertising, with A/B versions for paid campaigns, and directed three content shoots, including one in New York.

closing.label: The result
closing.text: Sara is now rated the top personal stylist in New York City. We would not dream of taking the credit, but we are proud to have been part of the journey.
